utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are we definitely doing the repair drive today, or is it still up in the air?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’re still on for today — I’m just waiting to hear if the tools have arrived. If they have, I’ll head over after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just let me know once you hear about the tools.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t heard the details yet—what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s set for Saturday morning at the community lot—people can drop off broken items, and the repair crew will sort them by what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds good—what time Saturday morning, and do people need to sign up ahead of time?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Dane — I’m ready to help organize the repair drive and keep everything running smoothly. What’s the first thing you’d like me to tackle?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Rosa—can you start by making a simple list of the repairs people are asking for? Then we can sort them by what’s most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course — I’ll make a simple list of the requested repairs and flag the urgent ones first. Send me whatever you’ve got, and I’ll get it organized.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive going on—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, it’s coming together nicely—folks are bringing in bikes, lamps, and a few wobbly chairs to fix up. If you need a tool, I’m happy to lend one over.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s great to hear—thanks, Gus. I might take you up on that tool if I swing by later.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what’s the first thing you need fixed?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Probably the back gate, if you’ve got a minute. It’s been sticking badly, and I can’t manage it alone.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can take a look at the back gate now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help repeat the plan around the neighborhood so everyone hears about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be a huge help, Vik — thank you. I’ll keep the details simple and make sure everyone knows where to go.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and keep it simple. Just send me the details, and I’ll repeat them around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Eli, I’m gathering folks for the repair drive—want me to put you on the list?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, please put me on the list. Just let me know the time and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll send the time as soon as it’s set, and you can just bring a pair of gloves if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a decent turnout so far—folks seem to be pitching in with tools and spare parts. If you’re planning to help, I can point you toward where they’re organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Tess. I’d appreciate that—I meant to bring my wrench, but I think I left it by the back door again.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: No worries, Oren—happens to the best of us. Swing by the setup table near the community shed, and I’ll show you where they’re sorting the tools.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school drop-off and pickup—what time does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think it starts around 9, but I’m not totally sure—I should check the flyer so we don’t miss it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’d be great—if you check the flyer, I can work around school drop-off and make sure we’re there on time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’m heading out for errands now, so I can spread the word about the repair drive too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, that’d help a lot. I’ll keep it simple and share the basics when I see folks.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, I’ll mention it around the block and keep it brief. Let me know if there’s anything specific you want me to tell people.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I haven’t checked the details yet, but I can swing by later and see what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Noah. I’d appreciate that—just let me know what you find.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yep, I’ll stop by later and take a look. If I spot anything, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Cleo, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, we’re still on. I’m keeping track of the supplies, so I’ll make sure we’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. Do you want me to bring anything else?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I’d want to know the drop-off time and whether we need to label everything first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m not totally sure yet—I only heard it’s this weekend, but I can ask around about the drop-off time and labels.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that’d help. I just don’t want us showing up with a car full of stuff and nowhere to leave it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure the repair drive is happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, it’s happening today — I’ve got my tools ready if anyone needs them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, just wanted to make sure.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep this simple—let’s set a clear time and see what’s needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That works for me—let’s pick a time and I’ll note what’s needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great—how about tomorrow at 10? Then we can make a quick list and keep the repair drive on track.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help spread the word about the repair drive. Let’s keep it simple and make sure everyone knows when and where it is.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — I’ll keep it short and sweet, then tell folks it’s this Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll repeat that it’s this Saturday at the community center and keep it short when I mention it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away. If you want, I can also invite a few more neighbors tonight.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, Quinn — thank you. I’ll get the flyer ready and bring a signup sheet tonight.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Rosa — I’ll start inviting people now and let them know to look for your flyer tonight.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Mara, sorry I’m late—did I miss the main details for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries — you didn’t miss much. I was just about to go over the main details for the repair drive with you.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — I’m all ears. What do you need me to help with?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I’ll need to keep it simple today.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s completely fine — simple is perfect. I can work around your schedule and just use whatever help you can give today.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Faye. I can spare a short stretch this afternoon and help with the easy parts.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great, Leo — could you bring a drill and maybe some extra screws? If you’ve got time, we could also use help checking the loose fence boards.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring a drill and extra screws, and I can check the loose fence boards too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got for the repair drive and note what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: That’d be great—thanks. Just let me know what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll take a quick look and make a list of anything we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what’s the best way for me to spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Jules — the easiest way is to share the date, time, and a quick note that folks can bring small broken items and sign up ahead of time if they can.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll share the date, time, and the sign-up note so people know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that—what needs fixing for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—thanks, Rey. I think it’s mostly the loose gate latch and that wobbly step by the drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I can take a look at the latch and the step. I’ll bring a few tools and stop by soon.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — could you confirm what items the repair drive is still missing and where you want them dropped off?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m not totally sure what’s still missing, but I can check the list and let you know. Could you drop the items by my porch for now?
